items.description: Audience Partners is an enterprise advertising management company that focuses on on healthcare, politics and public affairs. With the Audience Partners platform, customers will be able to micro-target different messages to different audience segments in order to increase engagement and return on their advertisement.
Online image editor with basic editing features and Flickr integration.
Wide collection of Arabic media including TV, radio, movies and clips.
Discussing based site as long as its about any place in the world. For example, plot your local school and tell everyone what you think of it. Plot your local bar and discuss its beer prices.
Get a list of frequent words/phrases used by specific twitter users.

This app is a mashup of Google Maps, an already existing Tropo application for Delaware transit locations and Phono. Since all of the Phono, Google Maps and jQuery pieces run in the client, there is no server-side logic need to make this application work. It’s all JavaScript.

Zuckerbucks are points that you can use like play money on Facebook. They have no cash value, but you can send them to friends as gifts, or as payment. You can also bid on real products featured within the Zuckerbucks app.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.
Find Country on Map is a simple game in which you have to click on a map where you think a country is.
Risk evolved into massive Google Maps game with 55 million cells and instant action Arena tournaments.
TravelSkoot is an itinerary planning tool. It allows travelers and locals to put together lists of destinations to create personalized itineraries called Skoots, and share them with their friends.
Embeddable driving directions widget. Create driving directions for your site, with an animated Street View tour of your route.
Qualis is a website for real estate in The Netherlands.
A mashup of the YouTube embedded player Javascript API and Google Maps. It plots the location of the race driver as the video plays.
Lets you find premiership soccer news by team location. Via Google Maps and BBC Backstage data.

Dunkathon is a HotOrNot version of basketball dunking clips. Videos are retrieved by filtering clips from YouTube API and only keep the ones that are relevant to dunking and short in length, 40 sec or less.
Free real estate search site using Google Maps, Streetview and Bing's Bird's eye view. Shows properties in Argentina, Spain and Uruguay.
Interactive game based on Google Maps API. Try to guess the correct country below the flag.
spoonacular is a semantic recipe search engine.
Randolunch selects a random restaurant for you to try based on your location. Perfect for when you can't decide where to eat!
This site draws video markers: click on a marker to see a video. You can also upload videos. 112 is the European equivalent of 911.
Google Maps can easily be customized to display searchable floor plans. A floor plan drawing in PDF, JPG, GIS, CAD formats, can be displayed on the map as seen in this example.
The lyrics instant search engine
Beginner and professional investors can create rules with filters for automatic portfolio management/investment on the P2P platform Bondora, using the Bondora API.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send files directly from their Box accounts to Drawloop, where they are converted into PDFs.
Slurlmarker uses your del.icio.us account to create a bookmark slurl of your favorite locations in Second Life.
Spying on FriendFeed public timeline in real time and more.
Passione non profit is an Italian site. It appears to be an aggregate of non profit blog posts.
Test your knowledge of where countries are located with this interactive map quiz.
What were you doing 1 year ago today? Each morning users are sent an email containing reminders of the past including, tweets, facebook posts, Instagram photos and foursquare checkins.
